display.purpose: Building name heading the monograph; once per screen. Width: semi (112%).

headline.purpose: Architect names, board error title; byline at weight 500 in oxblood. Width: semi (112%).

title.purpose: Uppercase wide tabular values in title-block cells and the zoom control. Width: semi (112%).

lead.purpose: Monograph opening paragraph at the md scale step (1.1875rem); lead and biographies max 62ch.

ui.purpose: Button labels and sheet tab names. Width: normal (100%).

label.purpose: Wide uppercase caps for cell, field, fact and slip labels. Width: wide (118%).

section-label.purpose: Hint tray and monograph section headings at wide (118%); the worksheet heading is 0.875rem at extra (125%) with 0.08em tracking on a 1.5px rule.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Full paper sheets: drawing sheets, guess worksheet, monograph, combobox listbox.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Small paper objects: hint slips, photo prints, zoom control, primary button.

shadows.name: rail
shadows.purpose: Header rail only: deep-chocolate edge line plus a short fall onto the mat.

shadows.name: tab
shadows.purpose: Selected sheet tab paper only; casts upward so the tab joins the sheet below.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Russet halo with russet border on focused inputs.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition (CSS --ease-out, motion.js easeOut).

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, color and press state changes.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Enter/exit fades, sheet exit, print un-tilt.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Sheet flip entry, image fade-in, zoom.

motion.name: plot
motion.purpose: Title-block values drawing in left to right as a guess locks or on reveal.

motion.name: sheet-flip
motion.value: enter x 6%*dir, rotate 0.5deg*dir, opacity 0; exit x -4%*dir, scale 0.985
motion.purpose: Directional page flip between sheets in the set.

motion.name: spring-soft
motion.purpose: Selected tab paper sliding between sheet tabs.

motion.name: plotter-sweep
motion.purpose: Loading state on the sheet; hidden under reduced motion.

narrative.northStar: The Drawing Set on the Table
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Drawing Set on the Table"**

The screen is a drafting table. A chocolate rail runs across the top like the edge of the desk; below it lies a saturated cream drafting mat ruled with a faint camel grid (8px fine, 40px major). On the mat sit sheets of paler paper, each with a hairline inner frame and a soft, lifted shadow. A building is presented the way architects document it: sheet by sheet, numbered (A-101, A-301), with a title block along the bottom edge that stays blank until the player earns the answer and then plots in cell by cell.

Everything is lettered like a drawing set. Labels on documents use Archivo stretched wide, uppercase and tracked, like title-block lettering; prose, inputs and buttons stay at normal width so the game stays easy to read. Width comes from a four-step stretch scale, not from ad hoc percentages. Numbers that identify things (sheet numbers, counts, years) are tabular. Photographs join the drawing set as P-numbered sheets after the cuts (A-101, A-301… then P-1 exterior, P-2 interior).

Density is calm and generous. The game is a stress-free study session: there are no scores, timers or celebratory effects, and motion follows the drafting metaphor. Sheets slide in from the direction you flip, values draw in from left to right like a pen plotter, and the board steps aside into a reference column when the monograph opens.
keyCharacteristics: Cream mat with a two-weight camel grid; paler paper sheets lifted above it.
Sheets with a 1.5px inner frame, zone references in the margins, and a ruled title block.
Archivo variable: wide uppercase caps for document lettering, normal width for UI and prose.
Oxblood for acting and selecting; russet for links, focus and correct answers.
Hatched poché placeholders that belong to the set rather than apologising for it.
Ease-out motion that follows drafting gestures (flip, plot, pin).

rules.name: The Camel Never Speaks Rule
rules.body: Camel is too light to read on cream. It draws grids, hatching and hairlines; it is never used for text or icons.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Oxblood means act, select or wrong. Russet means go somewhere, focus, or correct. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Title-Block Lettering Rule
rules.body: Wide uppercase caps are reserved for lettering on the drawing set: cell labels, field labels, section heads and sheet numbers. Sentences, buttons, inputs and prose stay at normal width and in sentence case.

rules.name: The Four Widths Rule
rules.body: Archivo's width axis takes only four values: normal (100%) for prose, inputs, buttons and the compact wordmark under 30rem; semi (112%) for display, headlines, title-block values and sheet numbers; wide (118%) for caps labels; extra (125%) for the wordmark and the worksheet heading. Never set an in-between percentage.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Sheet numbers, counts (2/3), years and dates use tabular numerals so they align like a drawing register.

rules.name: The Paper-on-Mat Rule
rules.body: Paper lifts at one of two levels (sheet or raised); the mat never casts a shadow. Beyond those, only the rail and the selected tab carry shadows, each its own token. No other shadows.

rules.name: The Inner Frame Rule
rules.body: A surface that is a document (drawing sheet, worksheet, monograph) carries a 1.5px inner frame. Slips and prints do not.

dos: **Do** put new documents on paper (`paper`) over the mat, with the sheet shadow and a 1.5px `paper-rule` inner frame.
**Do** letter labels on documents in Archivo at wide (118%) width, uppercase, 0.06em tracking, in soft chocolate; keep prose, inputs and buttons at normal width.
**Do** take every font width from the four-step stretch scale (100 / 112 / 118 / 125%).
**Do** use oxblood for the one primary action and selected state, and russet for links, focus and correct.
**Do** use the hatched poché placeholder with a framed caps note whenever an image is missing.
**Do** number sheets in the A-101 / A-301 convention with tabular figures.
**Do** animate with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 160 / 320 / 560ms, making motion follow a drafting gesture (flip, plot, pin).
donts: **Don't** set text or icons in camel; it is for grids, hatching and hairlines only.
**Don't** use neutral grey or black shadows, or add shadows beyond the four tokens (sheet, raised, rail, tab).
**Don't** round sheets, slips or prints, or go above 6px on controls; pills are only for the recap outcome chips.
**Don't** add a second typeface; vary Archivo's width axis instead.
**Don't** add scores, timers, streaks or celebratory effects to the game.
**Don't** tilt anything except photographic prints laid on the monograph.
